exposure: Prepregnancy BMI categories: underweight, normal weight, overweight, obesity class 1, obesity class 2, and obesity class 3
finding: While a crude association exists between high prepregnancy BMI and SMM, this association is largely explained by obesity-related co-morbidities and cesarean birth.
mod_finding: Obesity-related co-morbidities and cesarean birth mediated the association between high prepregnancy BMI and severe maternal morbidity.
